preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S_i <= 200000 for S_i in S)
preconditions.description: All elements in the set S must be distinct positive integers between 1 and 200000.
The set S must contain exactly n distinct integers.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the largest non-negative integer x.
The output must contain exactly 2^x integers after the first line.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) < 2**x for num in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All integers in the magical permutation must be within the range from 0 to 2^x - 1.
